title: AEGIS normalized multi-market futures bar, version 1
description: The single normalized interchange schema every futures market loads through (AEGIS-026). No floating-point prices: OHLC and settlement are integer tick counts, converted from decimal input by exact division against the product's tick_size (python/futures/ingest.py). record_index is assigned by ingestion and never recomputed downstream (M2 plan of record section 7). Registered through python/data/schema_registry.SchemaRegistry, not a second, parallel validator.

schema_version.description: Mandatory and enumerated, like every other AEGIS config schema: a record written against a future schema is rejected rather than silently reinterpreted.

contract_symbol.description: The canonical ContractId string (python/futures/identifiers.py). Only this spelling is accepted at ingestion -- vendor-specific alternate symbol formats are out of scope for M2.

event_time_ns.description: UTC integer nanoseconds. Ingestion requires this explicitly on every input record; it never parses or infers a timestamp.

volume.description: Nullable: absent on the input record means null here, never zero.

open_interest.description: Nullable: absent on the input record means null here, never zero.

source_sequence.description: The sequence number as it appeared in the source dataset. Part of the (contract_symbol, source_sequence) duplicate-detection identity.

record_index.description: Zero-based ordinal of this record within the canonical ingestion result, assigned once by ingestion over surviving records in (source_file, physical_position) order. Never recomputed by any downstream reader.
